text:
laura: Heads-up: rolling RBAC role matrix change to console at 08:30 PT. viewer/editor/admin split and new UI gating for key actions.

samir: copy. which actions are getting gated?

laura: `export/audit-download`, `kms-key-view` and workspace-level billing are gated to admin only by default. editors keep deploy + edit routes.

marta: question — do editors still see audit log entries inline? we should not leak KMS key metadata to editors.

alex: editors currently see log entries but fields are masked. need to verify masking isn't reversible.

marta: ok add a quick unit test for log masking and an e2e that checks UI hides the key id column for non-admins.

samir: found a small access-control bug in canary — editors on dedicated accounts could toggle key rotation UI due to stale policy cache.

laura: ugh. thanks for catching. is that reproducible?

samir: yes 100% on my repro steps:
```
1) login as editor@acme
2) open /org/123/keys
3) click kebab on key -> rotate
```
shows rotate modal.

alex: file an incident/bug with repro and tag infra/eng-runtime. this smells like policy cache TTL mismatch with the new role mapping.

samir: created bug #5234: https://phab.redwood/bug/5234 — title: "editor can access KMS rotate in canary due to stale policy cache". added logs and steps.

eng-security-bot: Added severity: P2. Notified eng-runtime and infra.

laura: plan: rollback UI gating feature flag in canary, patch policy cache invalidation, add automated test + manual verify, then re-enable gate with canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

marta: for the tests: add one for JS console that asserts `document.querySelector('.key-id') === null` for editor role, and a backend policy test asserting `can(editor, 'kms.rotate') == false`.

alex: also add audit events for policy-eval results. need events like `policy.evaluation.{allow|deny}` with actor, role, resource, reason. tie those to existing audit logging table.

laura: agreed. add a migration to include `policy_reason` in audit_events. keep default null.

samir: quick note on KMS integration: do we gate KMS key metadata by RBAC or by customer tenancy? i.e., some accounts share keys across teams.

laura: we gate by workspace ownership first, then role. if shared key, only admin of owning workspace + explicitly granted principals can view. document in runbook.

marta: doc link?

laura: https://redwood.internal/docs/rbac/key-gating (WIP) — add your section on shared-key patterns.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: console-canary v2025.11.18-rc2 by laura.

samir: after rollback of the feature flag in canary the rotate button is gone. verifying masking tests now.

marta: masking unit test added in PR #1289. backend policy test in #1290.

alex: also added a short section in console release notes about role changes and migration steps for customers who mapped custom roles.

laura: thanks team. after bug patch we'll run a focused audit: query audit_events for `kms.rotate` attempts from last 24h and verify no privilege escalation. assign to samir.

samir: on it. I ran query locally, 2 attempts from editor accounts — both from canary cluster. will include in bug.

laura: good. once patch lands let's do a 2h canary with increased logging and a quick customer-notify if we see repeats.

eng-security-bot: Reminder: please tag PRs with `security-review` label for RBAC changes.

marta: noted. adding checklist to PR template now.

laura: closing thread for async updates. will post re-enable timeline and CRA run when ready. :thumbsup:
